brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a grandparent preparing their home for visits from a young grandchild. Make the practical benefit relevant to visits without promising worry-free visits, universal compatibility or easy installation. This is a hypothetical audience scenario, not customer research.

variants.concept: Prepare exposed edges and corners before a visit
variants.primary_text: Expecting a young grandchild for a visit? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes edge and corner protectors to help cover exposed edges around the rooms you’ll share. It’s one practical part of getting the home ready before little feet arrive—while keeping adult supervision part of the visit. Explore the kit and choose the areas you want to prepare.
variants.headline: Prepare edges and corners for visits

variants.concept: Address sockets as part of visit preparation
variants.primary_text: Before a young grandchild visits, sockets may be one of the details you want to address around the home. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes socket guards, adding a childproofing measure around outlets as you prepare. They’re not a substitute for watching your grandchild, but can be part of your visit-ready checklist. See the kit details.
variants.headline: Socket guards for visit prep

variants.concept: Prepare kitchen and door areas, with installation video support
variants.primary_text: A visit can mean time in the kitchen and near doors, too. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes cabinet/fridge locks and door guards, so you can consider those spots as part of preparing your home for a young grandchild. If you’d like installation guidance, the offer includes 1-to-1 installation video support. Take a look at the kit.
variants.headline: Locks and door guards for visit prep

internal_notes: The grandparent visit scenario is hypothetical, not customer research.
Product and offer details come from the supplied dated website observations, not a fresh website check or independently verified safety evidence.
No image was supplied; copy is written to accompany the described kit photograph.
